extracted text: The paper describes an AlSi9Cu3(Fe) foundry alloy (EN AB-46000, equivalent to the US designation A380) produced by Raffineria Metalli Capra through aluminum scrap recovered from industrial waste and discarded post-consumer items. The die-castings have been stored at room temperature for about 5 months before being analyzed and were similar to a T1-condition. Vickers microhardness measurements ranged between 95 and 125 HV, with a mean value of about 110 HV. The tensile properties vary depending on the gage diameter of the specimens (6.0, 3.4, and 3.0 mm).
